subject: Security discovery recap — recommended questionnaire path & clarifying asks
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Megan Torres <megan.torres@ellaclinic.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@ellaclinic.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Security discovery recap — questionnaire path & clarifying asks

Thanks again for the call earlier today — quick recap and suggested path for the security questionnaire so we can keep momentum.

Key points from call:
- Ella Clinic will evaluate PHI-handling paths for the integration (patient metadata + notes).
- Primary hosting will be in us-west (your cloud), but you want options for EU residency for a subset of data.
- You are interested in a hosted Redwood API for initial pilot and possibly Dedicated later.

Recommended next step (my suggested path):
1) Start with a SIG-lite (Scoping + targeted evidence) to cover the high-impact controls for PHI and hosting.
2) Where SIG answers are not sufficient for infrastructure specifics, follow-up with a scoped CAIQ for the vendor-hosting profile.
3) Deliverables: SOC2 summary + SIG-lite answers + evidence bundle link.

Clarifying questions we need from your side to scope the SIG properly:
- Can you confirm whether the pilot will process ePHI (yes/no)? If yes, approximately how many unique patient records/month?
- Is Ella Clinic planning to manage encryption keys (BYOK) or will Redwood manage keys (we have KMS integrations)?
- Data residency: which datasets must remain in EU vs US? Are we talking metadata only or full record sets?
- Retention policy expectations and any upcoming audit/timeline (e.g., do you need evidence within 30 days)?

Attachments: I attached a short SIG-lite proposal (one-pager) and our SOC2 summary for reference. If you prefer CAIQ first, say so and we can route that instead.

If we get answers to the clarifying items above, I’ll route a focused SIG-lite with an evidence checklist and propose owners for each evidence item. Can we target an evidence handoff meeting next week?

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: EllaClinic-SIG-lite-proposal.pdf (stub)
Attachment: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (stub)

From: Megan Torres <megan.torres@ellaclinic.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@ellaclinic.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Jul 2026 09:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery recap — questionnaire path & clarifying asks

Thanks Rachel — this is super helpful. A few quick answers and a couple follow-ups: 

- ePHI: yes, the pilot will process PHI (patient IDs + visit notes). Estimated 12k unique patients/month during pilot.
- Keys: our preference is BYOK for production, but pilot can use vendor-managed keys if needed.
- Residency: EU residency required for a subset (~10% of records) — full records, not just metadata.
- Timeline: we have a security review window the week of July 20th. Evidence any time before July 16th would be ideal.

SIG vs CAIQ: from a compliance perspective we prefer a SIG-first approach for vendor variance, but if Redwood recommends CAIQ for hosting specifics we can accept a short CAIQ follow-up.

Can you confirm what evidence format you prefer (PDF extracts, system screenshots, or redacted logs)? Also please include a single point-of-contact on your side for the evidence handoff.

Best,
Megan Torres
Security PM, Ella Clinic
megan.torres@ellaclinic.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 11:04:00 +01:00
Subject: RE: Security discovery recap — questionnaire path & clarifying asks (internal)

Great recap, Rachel — a few internal notes and recommended owners before we send the formal SIG-lite: 

- Evidence approach: SIG-lite answers + one evidence bundle. Preferred formats: redacted screenshots + configuration export (where applicable) + SOC2 attestation PDF. Avoid handing full logs unless asked by their auditor.
- Keys: For BYOK, we need to confirm supported KMS providers. Marcus: can you confirm we support customer KMS for Dedicated and if pilot in hosted mode supports temporary BYOK?
- Residency: we'll propose a scoped answer that flags the 10% EU set and proposes a routing policy (EU region routing + data partition). Need eng confirmation on routing feasibility.
- Legal/Contract: recommend we loop legal early — likely contract side will request a data processing addendum (DPA) and possibly a BAA for PHI. Rachel: could you add Legal (legal@redwood.com) to the next thread once they confirm the SIG/CAIQ path?

Proposed internal owners for evidence collection: 
- SOC2 attestation: Marcus Lin (Compliance Ops)
- KV/config screenshots + KMS detail: Jonas Weber (Security Eng)
- Data residency / routing note: Rachel to confirm product owner on call with Ella Clinic.

I'll draft the SIG-lite template with a short, highlighted evidence checklist and share a Google Drive folder link (read-only) for them to upload evidence.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: (internal reference) SIG-lite-template-v1.docx (internal)

Thanks for the quick answers, Megan — that helps a lot. Next steps & proposed schedule: 

1) We will send a SIG-lite packet (short form + evidence checklist) by EOD tomorrow. This will include: SOC2 summary (attached), SIG-lite answer template, and an evidence checklist with suggested formats (PDF attestation, redacted screenshots).
2) Evidence handoff meeting: propose July 14th 11:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to walk through owners and earliest uploads. Does that work for your team?
3) Legal touchpoint: I will add our Legal (legal@redwood.com) on the thread once you confirm the SIG-lite route; Legal will prepare a DPA/BAA draft if needed.

Action items for Ella Clinic: please confirm the single POC for the evidence handoff and whether the pilot BYOK preference is firm for production.
